newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - LEHMAN RAISES OMV.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LEHMAN RAISES OMV.

text.p: Lehman Brothers raised its rating on Austrian oil group OMV to "outperform" from "neutral", and lifted its earnings estimates for 1997 and 1998, the investment bank said on Wednesday.
Earnings per share estimates for 1997 were raised to 106 schillings from 80 schillings, versus a consensus 94, and for 1998 to 114 from 112, above the consensus 110, Lehman said.

The upgrade was attributed to strong second quarter numbers, to be released August 19, above average growth in its core businesses, and the fact that forecast growth is not yet factored into the share price.
OMV also is committed to raising its dividend payout to the sector average, it said.
Lehman raised its target price to 2,000-2,1000.
"With strong commitment to cost cutting and profitable volume growth, OMV will be well positioned to outperform," Lehman said in a report. "We do not believe this is already in the price..."
